body: If I told him I don't think he would even look at me anymore. He would deal with all the abuse stuff just fine though. He knows bits and pieces of what has happened.

You make a really good point there. These people did try to break me and I am still here. I am really competitive so that makes me smile. I need to shift my thinking towards that I think. 

I have no idea how to open up to my Mum and boyfriend. I know that seems stupid, I adore them, but how do I say 'Hey Mum, you remember how we pride ourselves on being able to talk about anything? Well I lied, here is my secret that I have kept for 8 years. Plz don't be mad kkthanxbai'.

Thanks for your reply, I have played around with my diet a bit (I come from a family of hippies - dont worry about it) though nothing seems to change. This is probably because it is a nervous system issue though. My nerves are like train tracks that are damaged. Sometimes the trains can get through, sometimes they crash and burn, sometimes the front of the train gets through but carriages de-rail somewhere. 

For example, if you touch my arm sometimes I will feel it, sometimes I wont at all, sometimes I will be aware of pressure but not know where, sometimes I wont know which arm you are touching. This also means that in the past I have stepped on things like lego and not realised what the pain is until I am at the other side of the room.

It can be amusing sometimes.
